requirements.statement: Implement one three-host projection engine that consumes the exact frozen bundled-v2 run binding, applies fixed Codex copy and Copilot and Claude reference modes, publishes safe atomic projections and immutable receipts, performs complete read-only conformance, preserves idempotence, fails closed on conflicting or unsafe state, and proves all hosts agree on one official and project-pack identity without network or mutable rediscovery; the engine depends on REQ-PHASE4-RECEIPT-CONTRACT being available first.

path_bindings.ownership_evidence: This existing public host install and status engine owns the current Codex behavior and is the correct single behavioral owner for the three-host projection extension.

proof_bindings.asserted_behavior: Host mode selection, fingerprints, inventory comparison, receipt sealing, idempotence, and categorized conformance decisions are deterministic and filesystem-bounded.
Codex, Copilot, and Claude consume one frozen run-resolution contract and emit the approved host-projection receipt without mutable rediscovery or host-specific authority drift.

Temporary three-host repositories prove atomic copy and reference installation, complete read-only conformance, identity agreement, idempotent retry, and fail-closed negative states with no network access.

positive: One host projection engine consumes exactly one frozen bundled-v2 run binding and depends on the registered Phase 4 host-projection receipt contract.
Codex copy mode and Copilot and Claude reference modes publish bounded atomic projections and immutable receipts while preserving unmanaged instructions.
Read-only status recomputes complete receipt, instruction, mapping, and inventory evidence; all hosts agree on one official and project-pack identity; identical retries are idempotent.
Focused host proof covers positive conformance and missing, additional, altered, symlinked, non-regular, unsafe, stale, legacy, and conflicting negative cases.
negative: No host downloads, substitutes, rediscovers mutable selector state, accepts legacy authority, silently changes projection mode, or falls back from Full.
Unsafe ancestors, unmanaged conflicts, altered receipts, incomplete inventories, stale identity, and different frozen authority fail closed without overwrite.
Do not edit repository host instruction files, public Start or MCP wiring, Planning Lock, installers, bundle resolver, bridge, registry, schemas, packaging, documentation, or Phase 5 proof surfaces.
